definitions.explanation: A mistake caused by carelessness or lack of attention rather than lack of knowledge or ability. Implies the error was easily avoidable.

examples.japanese: {凡|ぼん}ミスで{点|てん}を{落|お}とした。
examples.english: I lost points due to a careless mistake.

examples.japanese: {計算|けいさん}の{凡|ぼん}ミスが{多|おお}いので{気|き}をつけなさい。
examples.english: You make a lot of careless calculation errors, so be careful.

examples.japanese: {大事|だいじ}な{試合|しあい}で{凡|ぼん}ミスを{連発|れんぱつ}してしまい、チームに{迷惑|めいわく}をかけた。
examples.english: I made one careless mistake after another in an important match and caused trouble for the team.

notes:
USAGE:
A hybrid word combining the kanji {凡|ぼん} (ordinary, mediocre) with the English loanword ミス (miss/mistake). Very common in school, sports, and work contexts. Often used self-critically.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {凡|ぼん}ミスをする: to make a careless mistake
- {凡|ぼん}ミスを{減|へ}らす: to reduce careless mistakes
- {凡|ぼん}ミスが{目立|めだ}つ: careless mistakes stand out
- {凡|ぼん}ミスを{連発|れんぱつ}する: to make careless mistakes in succession
